'''Shenecha Tortai''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] living during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. Residing in [[Kaas City]] on [[Dromund Kaas/Legends|Dromund Kaas]], Tortai also shared his knowledge of treasure hunting to others.
